### Growth-rate tables

These tables separate the three growth concepts used in the goals discussion so they are easier to compare without mixing observed and model-based quantities.

Interpretation:
a) `Table 1` is purely observed and shows the annualized growth rate between each pair of DHS surveys for each SSA country;
b) `Table 2` is purely model-based and shows the instantaneous annual growth rate by country and calendar year through `2025`;
c) `Table 3` is also model-based and shows the projected year-to-year annualized growth rate over each one-year interval from `2025-2026` through `2044-2045`;
d) the section then repeats those three table types for the weighted SSA region only and for the weighted priority geographies subgroup only;
e) all model-based growth values are shown in `pp/year`;
f) a value of `0.5` means `0.5 percentage points per year`, not `50%` growth.

```{r ssa-goals-final-growth-tables-setup}
ssa_goal_final_survey_to_survey_growth <- ssa_obs_growth_intervals %>%
  arrange(factor(region, levels = ssa_regions), country, prev_year, year) %>%
  transmute(
    Region = region,
    Country = country,
    `Survey Interval` = paste0(prev_year, "-", year),
    `Interval Length (years)` = year - prev_year,
    `Start mCPR (%)` = round(100 * prev_mcpr, 1),
    `End mCPR (%)` = round(100 * mCPR, 1),
    `Observed Annualized Growth (pp/year)` = round(100 * obs_growth_annual, 1)
  )

ssa_goal_final_model_growth_history <- country_growth_rate_table %>%
  filter(country %in% ssa_country_order_vec, year <= 2025) %>%
  left_join(
    ssa_goal_final_country_rows %>%
      select(geography, last_obs_year),
    by = c("country" = "geography")
  ) %>%
  arrange(factor(region, levels = ssa_regions), country, year) %>%
  transmute(
    Region = region,
    Country = country,
    Year = year,
    Window = if_else(
      year <= last_obs_year,
      "Within observed DHS window",
      "Model-only year before 2025"
    ),
    `Model Instantaneous Annualized Growth (pp/year)` = round(100 * dpdt_mean, 1),
    `95% CrI (pp/year)` = paste0(
      format(round(100 * dpdt_p05, 1), nsmall = 1),
      " to ",
      format(round(100 * dpdt_p95, 1), nsmall = 1)
    )
  )

ssa_goal_final_projected_growth_2025_2045 <- bind_rows(
  lapply(ssa_goal_final_base_year:(ssa_goal_final_target_year - 1), function(start_year) {
    p_start_draws <- logistic_draws_at_year(ssa_K_draws, ssa_t0_draws, ssa_s_draws, start_year)
    p_end_draws <- logistic_draws_at_year(ssa_K_draws, ssa_t0_draws, ssa_s_draws, start_year + 1)
    growth_draws <- 100 * (p_end_draws - p_start_draws)

    tibble(
      country = ssa_country_order_vec,
      `Projection Interval` = paste0(start_year, "-", start_year + 1),
      `Start Year` = start_year,
      `End Year` = start_year + 1,
      p_start_pct = 100 * colMeans(p_start_draws),
      p_end_pct = 100 * colMeans(p_end_draws),
      growth_pp_per_year = colMeans(growth_draws),
      growth_p05 = apply(growth_draws, 2, quantile, ci_lower),
      growth_p95 = apply(growth_draws, 2, quantile, ci_upper)
    )
  })
) %>%
  left_join(
    ssa_goal_final_country_rows %>%
      select(geography, region),
    by = c("country" = "geography")
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    factor(region, levels = ssa_regions),
    country,
    `Start Year`
  ) %>%
  transmute(
    Region = region,
    Country = country,
    `Projection Interval`,
    `Start Year`,
    `End Year`,
    `p(Start Year) (%)` = round(p_start_pct, 1),
    `p(End Year) (%)` = round(p_end_pct, 1),
    `Model-Projected Annualized Growth (pp/year)` = round(growth_pp_per_year, 1),
    `95% CrI (pp/year)` = paste0(
      format(round(growth_p05, 1), nsmall = 1),
      " to ",
      format(round(growth_p95, 1), nsmall = 1)
    )
  )

build_weighted_observed_interval_table <- function(observed_df, geography_label) {
  observed_df %>%
    arrange(year) %>%
    mutate(
      prev_year = lag(year),
      prev_mcpr = lag(observed_weighted_mcpr)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(prev_year), year > prev_year) %>%
    transmute(
      Geography = geography_label,
      `Observed Interval` = paste0(prev_year, "-", year),
      `Interval Length (years)` = year - prev_year,
      `Start mCPR (%)` = round(100 * prev_mcpr, 1),
      `End mCPR (%)` = round(100 * observed_weighted_mcpr, 1),
      `Observed Annualized Growth (pp/year)` = round(
        100 * (observed_weighted_mcpr - prev_mcpr) / (year - prev_year),
        1
      )
    )
}

build_weighted_model_growth_history_table <- function(country_names, geography_label) {
  year_seq <- seq(
    min(mcpr_logistic_data$year[mcpr_logistic_data$country %in% country_names], na.rm = TRUE),
    2025,
    by = 1
  )
  growth_draws <- sapply(year_seq, function(yy) {
    weighted_country_dpdt_draws_at_year(country_names, yy)
  })
  if (is.vector(growth_draws)) {
    growth_draws <- matrix(growth_draws, nrow = length(growth_draws), ncol = 1)
  }
  tibble(
    Geography = geography_label,
    Year = year_seq,
    `Model Instantaneous Annualized Growth (pp/year)` = round(100 * colMeans(growth_draws), 1),
    `95% CrI (pp/year)` = paste0(
      format(round(100 * apply(growth_draws, 2, quantile, ci_lower), 1), nsmall = 1),
      " to ",
      format(round(100 * apply(growth_draws, 2, quantile, ci_upper), 1), nsmall = 1)
    )
  )
}

build_weighted_projected_growth_table <- function(country_names, geography_label) {
  bind_rows(
    lapply(ssa_goal_final_base_year:(ssa_goal_final_target_year - 1), function(start_year) {
      p_start_draws <- weighted_country_draws_at_year(country_names, start_year)
      p_end_draws <- weighted_country_draws_at_year(country_names, start_year + 1)
      growth_draws <- 100 * (p_end_draws - p_start_draws)
      tibble(
        Geography = geography_label,
        `Projection Interval` = paste0(start_year, "-", start_year + 1),
        `Start Year` = start_year,
        `End Year` = start_year + 1,
        `p(Start Year) (%)` = round(100 * mean(p_start_draws), 1),
        `p(End Year) (%)` = round(100 * mean(p_end_draws), 1),
        `Model-Projected Annualized Growth (pp/year)` = round(mean(growth_draws), 1),
        `95% CrI (pp/year)` = paste0(
          format(round(quantile(growth_draws, ci_lower), 1), nsmall = 1),
          " to ",
          format(round(quantile(growth_draws, ci_upper), 1), nsmall = 1)
        )
      )
    })
  )
}

ssa_goal_final_priority_observed_weighted <- mcpr_logistic_data %>%
  filter(region %in% ssa_regions, country %in% ssa_goal_final_priority_geographies) %>%
  inner_join(
    ssa_pop_weights_model %>%
      filter(country %in% ssa_goal_final_priority_geographies) %>%
      select(country, Year, women_15_49),
    by = c("country", "year" = "Year")
  ) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    observed_weighted_mcpr = weighted.mean(mCPR, women_15_49, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ssa_goal_final_growth_region_observed <- build_weighted_observed_interval_table(
  ssa_observed_weighted,
  "Sub-Saharan Africa (weighted)"
)

ssa_goal_final_growth_region_model_history <- build_weighted_model_growth_history_table(
  ssa_country_order_vec,
  "Sub-Saharan Africa (weighted)"
)

ssa_goal_final_growth_region_projected <- build_weighted_projected_growth_table(
  ssa_country_order_vec,
  "Sub-Saharan Africa (weighted)"
)

ssa_goal_final_growth_priority_observed <- build_weighted_observed_interval_table(
  ssa_goal_final_priority_observed_weighted,
  ssa_goal_final_priority_label
)

ssa_goal_final_growth_priority_model_history <- build_weighted_model_growth_history_table(
  ssa_goal_final_priority_geographies,
  ssa_goal_final_priority_label
)

ssa_goal_final_growth_priority_projected <- build_weighted_projected_growth_table(
  ssa_goal_final_priority_geographies,
  ssa_goal_final_priority_label
)
```

### Is the required annualized growth rate realistic?

This comparison keeps the required annualized growth rate on a common 2025 to 2045 footing and places it beside three benchmarks:
a) the latest observed annualized inter-survey growth;
b) the model-implied annual growth at 2025;
c) the average model-projected annual growth from 2025 to 2045.

### mCPR(2025) versus fitted K

This asymptote-style check keeps the focus on current modeled position versus the fitted ceiling.

Interpretation:
a) the dark point is the latest observed mCPR;
b) the blue point is the model-estimated `p(2025)`;
c) the gold point is the fitted ceiling `K`;
d) the gold error bar is the 95% credible interval for `K`;
e) the weighted SSA region is shown first, then countries are ordered from highest fitted `K` to lowest fitted `K`;
f) the right-side labels show fitted `K`;
g) the vertical reference line is the 40% target;
h) geographies whose fitted `K` sits near or below 40% have limited modeled headroom even if `p(2025)` is still below target.

```{r ssa-goals-final-asymptote-p2025, fig.height=9}
ggplot(ssa_goal_final_asymptote_p2025, aes(y = geography_plot)) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 40,
    linetype = "dashed",
    color = "#7F1D1D",
    linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_errorbarh(
    aes(
      xmin = K_p05_pct,
      xmax = K_p95_pct
    ),
    height = 0.24,
    linewidth = 0.95,
    color = "#B45309"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      x = current_latest_obs_plot_pct,
      fill = "Latest observed mCPR"
    ),
    shape = 21,
    size = 3.25,
    color = ssa_goal_final_asymptote_outline_cols["Latest observed mCPR"],
    stroke = 0.45
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      x = current_p2025_pct,
      fill = "Model-estimated mCPR(2025)"
    ),
    size = 3.25,
    color = ssa_goal_final_asymptote_outline_cols["Model-estimated mCPR(2025)"],
    stroke = 0.45,
    shape = 21
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(
      x = K_mean_pct,
      fill = "Fitted K"
    ),
    shape = 21,
    size = 3.25,
    color = ssa_goal_final_asymptote_outline_cols["Fitted K"],
    stroke = 0.45
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = ssa_goal_final_asymptote_fill_cols,
    breaks = c("Latest observed mCPR", "Model-estimated mCPR(2025)", "Fitted K")
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = priority_country_axis_labels) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(
      0,
      max(ssa_goal_final_asymptote_p2025$K_p95_pct, na.rm = TRUE) + 4
    ),
    breaks = function(x) sort(unique(c(pretty(x, n = 7), 40))),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.01))
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12.9) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14.6, color = "grey15"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12.6, color = "grey15"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16.0, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12.5),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16.4, face = "bold"),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 16, 10, 10)
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(
      nrow = 1,
      byrow = TRUE,
      override.aes = list(
        shape = c(21, 21, 21),
        color = unname(ssa_goal_final_asymptote_outline_cols[c(
          "Latest observed mCPR",
          "Model-estimated mCPR(2025)",
          "Fitted K"
        )]),
        size = c(3.35, 3.35, 3.35),
        stroke = c(0.45, 0.45, 0.45)
      )
    )
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  labs(
    title = "Model-estimated mCPR(2025) versus fitted K for SSA, by country",
    x = "mCPR or fitted K (%)",
    y = NULL
  )
```

### Required annualized growth rate versus model-implied current annualized growth rate

This is the cleanest single-view feasibility graph for the 40% target.

Interpretation:
a) the x-axis is the annual growth required to move from `p(2025)` to 40% by 2045;
b) the y-axis is the model-implied annual growth rate at `2025`;
c) the dotted 45-degree line is the diagonal reference line;
d) points above the dotted line are outperforming the annualized growth rate needed to reach 40% by 2045 under the current fitted trajectory;
e) points below the dotted line would need acceleration relative to the model-implied current annualized growth rate;
f) red points have fitted `K` mostly below 40%, so even fast current growth does not by itself solve the ceiling problem.

```{r ssa-goals-final-feasibility-scatter, fig.height=10}
ssa_goal_final_feasibility_limits <- range(
  c(
    ssa_goal_final_feasibility$required_growth_from_p2025_pp_per_year,
    ssa_goal_final_feasibility$model_dpdt_2025_pp_per_year,
```

### Projected-path acceleration gap to 2045

The current-growth graph above is helpful, but it can overstate who is really on track. A country can look fast in `2025` simply because it is in the steep middle of the S curve, even if that pace later slows before `2045`.

This section answers a simpler question: if we follow the model's full projected path from `2025` to `2045`, is that projected pace enough to reach `40%`?

Interpretation:
a) the red benchmark is the annualized growth required from `mCPR(2025)` to reach `40%` by `2045`;
b) the compared projected value is the model's **average projected annualized growth** over the full `2025` to `2045` path;
c) because the projected value uses the full path, it already builds in S-curve deceleration as countries move toward `K`.

Important reading note:
- `estimated mCPR(2045)` means the model's projected **mCPR level in 2045** under the fitted trajectory.
- It is **not** a probability.
- The probability is shown separately as `P(cross by 2045)`, which is the share of posterior draws that reach or exceed `40%` by `2045`.


The same projected-path comparison can also be read as a slopegraph: each geography is one line connecting the annualized growth required from `p(2025)` to the model's average projected annualized growth from `2025` to `2045`.

### Growth-rate paths for SSA, the weighted priority geographies, and the 7 priority countries

These panels translate the acceleration question into growth-rate trajectories:
a) the blue line is the model-implied instantaneous annual growth rate over time;
b) the grey band is the 95% credible interval around that growth path;
c) the red dashed horizontal line is the annualized growth rate required from `p(2025)` to reach 40% by `2045`;
d) the teal dot-dashed horizontal line is the model's average projected annualized growth rate from `2025` to `2045`;
e) the dark point marks the current model-implied annual growth rate at `2025`;
f) if the blue path sits below the red line for much of the `2025` to `2045` window, the geography is not truly on track even if current growth is temporarily high.

```{r ssa-goals-final-growth-focus-panels, fig.height=16}
ggplot(
  ssa_goal_final_growth_focus_plot,

) +
```

### Weighted SSA region and all country trajectories relative to 40%

The first panel is the population-weighted SSA region. Each country panel then shows:
a) observed DHS points or weighted regional observed points;
b) a solid fitted trajectory with 95% credible interval;
c) the 40% goal as a horizontal dashed line;
d) the black vertical guide line marks the goal year 2045;
e) the fitted ceiling `K` as a dotted horizontal line;
f) the year the trajectory reaches approximately 99% of fitted `K` as a dotted vertical line;
g) a top-left label showing whether the mean projection is expected to cross before or after 2045, together with the posterior probability of crossing by 2045.

### Counterfactual lift to the weighted SSA mean if one not-on-track country reached 40% by 2045

This counterfactual holds every other country at its fitted `2045` level and asks: if one country that is **not** currently projected to cross `40%` by `2045` were instead brought up to `40%`, how much would the weighted SSA estimated `mCPR(2045)` move?

Interpretation:
a) bars show the average lift to the weighted SSA estimated `mCPR(2045)`;
b) countries are ranked from the largest lift to the smallest lift;
c) the biggest lifts come from a combination of large population weight and a large remaining shortfall to `40%` in `2045`.

```{r ssa-goals-final-counterfactual-lift-setup}
ssa_goal_final_lift_if40_mat <- sweep(
  pmax(target_mcpr_40 - ssa_p2045_draws, 0),
  2,
  ssa_weight_vec_latest,
  `*`
)

ssa_goal_final_weighted_ssa_p2045_pct <- 100 * mean(ssa_region_p2045_draws_final)
ssa_goal_final_lift_if40_mean <- 100 * colMeans(ssa_goal_final_lift_if40_mat)
ssa_goal_final_lift_if40_p05 <- 100 * apply(ssa_goal_final_lift_if40_mat, 2, quantile, ci_lower)
ssa_goal_final_lift_if40_p95 <- 100 * apply(ssa_goal_final_lift_if40_mat, 2, quantile, ci_upper)

ssa_goal_final_counterfactual_lift <- ssa_goal_final_country_rows %>%
  filter(!trajectory_status_final %in% c(
    "Already crossed",
    paste0("Projected to cross by ", ssa_goal_final_target_year)
  )) %>%
  mutate(
    lift_if_hit_40_pp = ssa_goal_final_lift_if40_mean[match(geography, ssa_country_order_vec)],
    lift_if_hit_40_p05 = ssa_goal_final_lift_if40_p05[match(geography, ssa_country_order_vec)],
    lift_if_hit_40_p95 = ssa_goal_final_lift_if40_p95[match(geography, ssa_country_order_vec)]
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(lift_if_hit_40_pp), geography)

ssa_goal_final_counterfactual_lift <- ssa_goal_final_counterfactual_lift %>%
  mutate(
    geography_label_plot = factor(
    geography_label,
      levels = rev(ssa_goal_final_counterfactual_lift$geography_label),
      ordered = TRUE
    ),
    counterfactual_ssa_p2045_pct = ssa_goal_final_weighted_ssa_p2045_pct + lift_if_hit_40_pp,
    label_x = pmax(lift_if_hit_40_pp, lift_if_hit_40_p95) + 0.04,
    label_text = paste0(
      format(round(lift_if_hit_40_pp, 2), nsmall = 2),
      " pp | SSA ",
      format(round(counterfactual_ssa_p2045_pct, 1), nsmall = 1),
      "%"
    )
  )
```

```{r ssa-goals-final-counterfactual-lift, fig.height=8.2}
      "thin horizontal lines show the 95% posterior interval for that lift. Labels show both the lift and the implied SSA weighted estimated mCPR(2045)."
    ),
    x = "Lift to weighted SSA estimated mCPR(2045) (percentage points)",
    y = NULL
  )
```

### Which countries have the most leverage on the weighted SSA estimated mCPR(2025)?

This is a **leave-one-out leverage** diagnostic, not just a population ranking. For each country, we remove that country, renormalize the remaining SSA weights, and then measure how much the weighted SSA estimated `mCPR(2025)` would change.

That means:
a) large countries matter more;
b) but countries close to the weighted SSA mean matter less than similarly large countries far above or below it;
c) positive bars mean the country is pulling the weighted SSA mean upward, while negative bars mean it is pulling the weighted SSA mean downward.

```{r ssa-goals-final-leverage-setup}
ssa_goal_final_region_p2025_mean <- ssa_region_goals_summary$p2025_mean
ssa_goal_final_region_p2045_mean <- mean(ssa_region_p2045_draws_final)

ssa_goal_final_leverage_2025 <- ssa_goal_final_country_rows %>%
  mutate(
    p_country_mean = current_p2025_pct / 100,
    leave_one_out_mean = (ssa_goal_final_region_p2025_mean - weight_share_ssa * p_country_mean) /
      pmax(1 - weight_share_ssa, 1e-9),
    leverage_shift_pp = 100 * (ssa_goal_final_region_p2025_mean - leave_one_out_mean),
    leverage_shift_abs_pp = abs(leverage_shift_pp),
    leverage_direction = if_else(
      leverage_shift_pp >= 0,
      "Lifts weighted SSA mean",
      "Pulls weighted SSA mean down"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(leverage_shift_abs_pp), desc(leverage_shift_pp), geography)

ssa_goal_final_leverage_2025 <- ssa_goal_final_leverage_2025 %>%
  mutate(
    geography_label_plot = factor(
      geography_label,
      levels = rev(ssa_goal_final_leverage_2025$geography_label),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )

ssa_goal_final_leverage_2045 <- ssa_goal_final_country_rows %>%
  mutate(
    p_country_mean = current_p2045_pct / 100,
    leave_one_out_mean = (ssa_goal_final_region_p2045_mean - weight_share_ssa * p_country_mean) /
      pmax(1 - weight_share_ssa, 1e-9),
    leverage_shift_pp = 100 * (ssa_goal_final_region_p2045_mean - leave_one_out_mean),
    leverage_shift_abs_pp = abs(leverage_shift_pp),
    leverage_direction = if_else(
      leverage_shift_pp >= 0,
      "Lifts weighted SSA mean",
      "Pulls weighted SSA mean down"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(leverage_shift_abs_pp), desc(leverage_shift_pp), geography)

ssa_goal_final_leverage_2045 <- ssa_goal_final_leverage_2045 %>%
  mutate(
    geography_label_plot = factor(
      geography_label,
      levels = rev(ssa_goal_final_leverage_2045$geography_label),
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )

ssa_goal_final_leverage_cols <- c(
  "Lifts weighted SSA mean" = "#047857",
  "Pulls weighted SSA mean down" = "#B91C1C"
)
```

```{r ssa-goals-final-leverage-2025, fig.height=9}
ggplot(
  ssa_goal_final_leverage_2025,
  aes(x = leverage_shift_pp, y = geography_label_plot, fill = leverage_direction)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72, alpha = 0.94) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey35", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ssa_goal_final_leverage_cols) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10.9) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8.7)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Goals - final:\nleave-one-out leverage on weighted SSA estimated mCPR(2025)",
    subtitle = "Countries are ranked by the absolute size of the shift. Positive bars lift the weighted SSA mean above the rest-of-SSA mean;\nnegative bars pull it below the rest-of-SSA mean.",
    x = "Change in weighted SSA estimated mCPR(2025) if omitted (percentage points)",
    y = NULL
  )
```

### Which countries have the most leverage on the weighted SSA estimated mCPR(2045)?

This repeats the same leave-one-out leverage idea, but now for the fitted `2045` endpoint. It answers a forward-looking question: which countries are doing the most to pull the weighted SSA estimated `mCPR(2045)` upward or downward under the fitted trajectory?

```{r ssa-goals-final-leverage-2045, fig.height=9}
ggplot(
  ssa_goal_final_leverage_2045,
  aes(x = leverage_shift_pp, y = geography_label_plot, fill = leverage_direction)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.72, alpha = 0.94) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey35", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ssa_goal_final_leverage_cols) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10.9) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8.7)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Goals - final:\nleave-one-out leverage on weighted SSA estimated mCPR(2045)",
    subtitle = "Countries are ranked by the absolute size of the shift. This is the 2045 version of the same leverage diagnostic,\nso large bars reflect a combination of population size and distance from the weighted SSA projected mean.",
    x = "Change in weighted SSA estimated mCPR(2045) if omitted (percentage points)",
    y = NULL
  )
```

### Counterfactual weighted SSA trajectories if one priority country reached 40% by 2045

This is the trajectory version of the leverage idea. We start from the fitted weighted SSA regional trajectory, then take one priority country at a time and ask: if that country were instead brought to `40%` by `2045`, how much higher would the weighted SSA path sit?

Interpretation:
a) the grey dashed line is the baseline weighted SSA fitted trajectory;
b) each colored line is a one-country counterfactual that only changes one priority country, while all other countries stay on their fitted paths;
c) the biggest lifts come from the countries whose endpoint labels add the largest number of percentage points to the weighted SSA estimated `mCPR(2045)`;
d) only priority countries that are not already on track to cross `40%` by `2045` are shown, because on-track countries would mostly overlap the baseline.

```{r ssa-goals-final-priority-counterfactual-trajectory-setup}
smoothstep_counterfactual <- function(x) {
  x <- pmin(pmax(x, 0), 1)
  x^2 * (3 - 2 * x)
}

ssa_goal_final_priority_counterfactual_meta <- ssa_goal_final_country_rows %>%
  filter(geography %in% ssa_goal_final_priority_geographies) %>%
  mutate(
    on_track_by_goal = trajectory_status_final %in% c(
      "Already crossed",
      paste0("Projected to cross by ", ssa_goal_final_target_year)
    ),
    scenario_gap_to_40 = pmax(target_mcpr_40 - current_p2045_pct / 100, 0),
    scenario_lift_2045_pp = 100 * weight_share_ssa * scenario_gap_to_40
  ) %>%
  filter(!on_track_by_goal, scenario_gap_to_40 > 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(scenario_lift_2045_pp), geography) %>%
  mutate(
    leverage_rank = row_number(),
    leverage_tier = if_else(leverage_rank <= 3, "Top leverage scenario", "Other leverage scenario"),
    scenario_panel_label = paste0("If ", geography, " hits 40% by ", ssa_goal_final_target_year),
    scenario_display_label = paste0("If ", geography, " hits goal")
  )

ssa_goal_final_priority_counterfactual_meta <- ssa_goal_final_priority_counterfactual_meta %>%
  mutate(
    scenario_panel_label = factor(
      scenario_panel_label,
      levels = scenario_panel_label,
      ordered = TRUE
    )
  )

ssa_goal_final_priority_counterfactual_cols <- c(
  "Nigeria" = "#4E79A7",
  "Ethiopia" = "#F28E2B",
  "Burkina Faso" = "#59A14F",
  "Cote d'Ivoire" = "#E15759",
  "Senegal" = "#76B7B2",
  "Niger" = "#B07AA1"
)

ssa_goal_final_region_baseline_2025_2045 <- ssa_goal_final_traj_region %>%
  filter(year >= 2025, year <= ssa_goal_final_target_year) %>%
  transmute(
    year,
    baseline_ssa_mcpr_pct = 100 * p_mean
  )

ssa_goal_final_weighted_ssa_p2025_pct <- ssa_goal_final_region_baseline_2025_2045 %>%
  filter(year == 2025) %>%
  pull(baseline_ssa_mcpr_pct)

ssa_goal_final_priority_counterfactual_ymin <- 20
ssa_goal_final_priority_counterfactual_ymax <- 60

ssa_goal_final_priority_counterfactual_plot <- bind_rows(
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(ssa_goal_final_priority_counterfactual_meta)), function(i) {
    meta_i <- ssa_goal_final_priority_counterfactual_meta[i, ]
    baseline_country_path <- ssa_goal_final_traj_country %>%
      filter(geography == meta_i$geography, year >= 2025, year <= ssa_goal_final_target_year) %>%
      arrange(year)

    tibble(
      geography = meta_i$geography,
      geography_label = meta_i$geography_label,
      scenario_panel_label = meta_i$scenario_panel_label,
      leverage_rank = meta_i$leverage_rank,
      leverage_tier = meta_i$leverage_tier,
      year = baseline_country_path$year,
      year_progress = (baseline_country_path$year - 2025) / (ssa_goal_final_target_year - 2025),
      baseline_country_mcpr = baseline_country_path$p_mean,
      scenario_country_mcpr = pmin(
        baseline_country_path$p_mean +
          meta_i$scenario_gap_to_40 * smoothstep_counterfactual(year_progress),
        target_mcpr_40
      )
    ) %>%
      left_join(ssa_goal_final_region_baseline_2025_2045, by = "year") %>%
      mutate(
        scenario_ssa_mcpr_pct = baseline_ssa_mcpr_pct +
          100 * meta_i$weight_share_ssa * (scenario_country_mcpr - baseline_country_mcpr),
        scenario_lift_pp = scenario_ssa_mcpr_pct - baseline_ssa_mcpr_pct
      )
  })
)

ssa_goal_final_priority_counterfactual_labels <- ssa_goal_final_priority_counterfactual_plot %>%
  group_by(geography, geography_label, scenario_panel_label, leverage_rank, leverage_tier) %>%
  filter(year == max(year)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(
    ssa_goal_final_priority_counterfactual_meta %>%
      select(geography, scenario_display_label),
    by = "geography"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    label_text = paste0(
      scenario_display_label,
      "\n+",
      format(round(scenario_lift_pp, 2), nsmall = 2),
      " pp\nSSA ",
      format(round(scenario_ssa_mcpr_pct, 1), nsmall = 1),
      "%"
    ),
    label_x = ssa_goal_final_target_year,
    label_y = pmin(
      scenario_ssa_mcpr_pct + 1.4,
      ssa_goal_final_priority_counterfactual_ymax - 1.1
    )
  )

ssa_goal_final_priority_counterfactual_lift_labels <- ssa_goal_final_priority_counterfactual_plot %>%
  group_by(geography, geography_label, scenario_panel_label, leverage_rank, leverage_tier) %>%
  filter(year == max(year)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(
    ssa_goal_final_priority_counterfactual_meta %>%
      select(geography, scenario_display_label),
    by = "geography"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    label_text = paste0(
      scenario_display_label,
      "\n+",
      format(round(scenario_lift_pp, 2), nsmall = 2),
      " pp"
    ),
    label_x = ssa_goal_final_target_year,
    label_y = scenario_lift_pp + 0.08
  )

ssa_goal_final_priority_counterfactual_2045_summary <- ssa_goal_final_country_rows %>%
  filter(geography %in% ssa_goal_final_priority_geographies) %>%
  transmute(
    geography,
    region,
    weight_share_ssa,
    baseline_country_2045_pct = current_p2045_pct,
    counterfactual_country_2045_pct = pmax(current_p2045_pct, 40),
    baseline_ssa_2045_pct = ssa_goal_final_weighted_ssa_p2045_pct,
    counterfactual_ssa_2045_pct =
      ssa_goal_final_weighted_ssa_p2045_pct +
      weight_share_ssa * (pmax(current_p2045_pct, 40) - current_p2045_pct),
    shift_from_baseline_pp = counterfactual_ssa_2045_pct - ssa_goal_final_weighted_ssa_p2045_pct,
    trajectory_status_final
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    gap_to_40_after_scenario_pp = pmax(40 - counterfactual_ssa_2045_pct, 0),
    scenario_display_label = paste0("If ", geography, " hits goal"),
    bar_label = paste0(
      format(round(counterfactual_ssa_2045_pct, 1), nsmall = 1),
      "% | +",
      format(round(shift_from_baseline_pp, 2), nsmall = 2),
      " pp"
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(shift_from_baseline_pp), geography) %>%
  mutate(
    scenario_display_label_plot = factor(
      scenario_display_label,
      levels = rev(scenario_display_label),
      ordered = TRUE
    ),
    label_x = shift_from_baseline_pp + 0.06
  )

readr::write_csv(
  ssa_goal_final_priority_counterfactual_2045_summary %>%
    select(
      geography,
      region,
      trajectory_status_final,
      weight_share_ssa,
      baseline_country_2045_pct,
      counterfactual_country_2045_pct,
      baseline_ssa_2045_pct,
      counterfactual_ssa_2045_pct,
      shift_from_baseline_pp,
      gap_to_40_after_scenario_pp
    ),
  "priority_geographies_counterfactual_ssa_2045_fpet_best_compromise.csv"
)
```

```{r ssa-goals-final-priority-counterfactual-trajectory, fig.width=14.4, fig.height=12.2}
ggplot(ssa_goal_final_priority_counterfactual_plot, aes(x = year, y = scenario_ssa_mcpr_pct, color = geography)) +

  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Goals - final:\nweighted SSA scenario trajectories if one priority country hits 40% by 2045",
    subtitle = paste0(
      "Baseline weighted SSA estimated mCPR rises from ",
      format(round(ssa_goal_final_weighted_ssa_p2025_pct, 1), nsmall = 1),
```

```{r ssa-goals-final-priority-counterfactual-2045-table}
ssa_goal_final_priority_counterfactual_2045_table <- bind_rows(
  tibble(
    Scenario = "Baseline (no change)",
    ssa_mcpr_2045 = ssa_goal_final_weighted_ssa_p2045_pct,
    shift_from_baseline_pp = 0
  ),
  tibble(
    Scenario = "Priority geographies baseline",
    ssa_mcpr_2045 = ssa_goal_final_priority_row$current_p2045_pct,
    shift_from_baseline_pp =
      ssa_goal_final_priority_row$current_p2045_pct - ssa_goal_final_weighted_ssa_p2045_pct
  ),
  ssa_goal_final_priority_counterfactual_2045_summary %>%
    transmute(
      Scenario = paste0(geography, " hits 40%"),
      ssa_mcpr_2045 = counterfactual_ssa_2045_pct,
      shift_from_baseline_pp = shift_from_baseline_pp
    )
) %>%
  mutate(
    ssa_mcpr_2045 = paste0(
      "<span style='display:inline-block; min-width:5.4em; text-align:right;'>",
      format(round(ssa_mcpr_2045, 1), nsmall = 1),
      "</span>"
    ),
    shift_from_baseline_pp = paste0(
      "<span style='display:inline-block; min-width:7.2em; text-align:right; padding-left:1.2em;'>",
      format(round(shift_from_baseline_pp, 2), nsmall = 2),
      "</span>"
    )
  )

knitr::kable(
  ssa_goal_final_priority_counterfactual_2045_table,
  format = "html",
  escape = FALSE,
  col.names = c(
    "Scenario",
    "SSA mCPR(2045)",
    "<span style='display:inline-block; min-width:7.6em; text-align:right; padding-left:1.2em;'>Shift from baseline<br>(pp)</span>"
  ),
  caption = paste0(
    "Counterfactual weighted SSA 2045 outcomes under priority-geography scenarios."
  ),
  align = c("l", "r", "r"),
  table.attr = "style='width:auto;'"
)
```

### Estimated mCPR(2025) across SSA, the weighted priority geographies, and all countries

This closes the goals section with one common-footing level view. The first bar is the weighted SSA estimate for `mCPR(2025)`, the second bar is the weighted estimate across the seven priority geographies, the next seven bars are the priority countries themselves, and the remaining bars are all other SSA countries.

Interpretation:
a) blue marks the weighted SSA benchmark;
b) orange marks the weighted priority-geography benchmark;
c) green marks the seven priority countries;
d) grey marks every other SSA country;
e) the dashed red line marks the `40%` goal.

```{r ssa-goals-final-p2025-level-bars, fig.width=14.4, fig.height=12.4}
ssa_goal_final_p2025_level_plot <- ssa_goal_final_all %>%
  mutate(
    plot_group_order = case_when(
      geography == "Sub-Saharan Africa (weighted)" ~ 1L,
      geography == ssa_goal_final_priority_label ~ 2L,
      geography %in% ssa_goal_final_priority_geographies ~ 3L,
      TRUE ~ 4L
    ),
    priority_country_order = match(geography, ssa_goal_final_priority_geographies),
    display_label = geography,
    goal_fill_group = factor(case_when(
      geography == "Sub-Saharan Africa (weighted)" ~ "SSA weighted",
      geography == ssa_goal_final_priority_label ~ "Priority geographies weighted",
      geography %in% ssa_goal_final_priority_geographies ~ "Priority countries",
      TRUE ~ "Other countries"
    ), levels = ssa_goal_final_focus_group_levels)
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    plot_group_order,
    priority_country_order,
    desc(current_p2025_pct),
    geography
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    display_label = factor(display_label, levels = rev(display_label), ordered = TRUE)
  )

ssa_goal_final_p2025_level_labels <- ssa_goal_final_p2025_level_plot %>%
  mutate(
    label_text = paste0(format(round(current_p2025_pct, 1), nsmall = 1), "%"),
    label_x = current_p2025_pct + 0.8
  )

ssa_goal_final_p2025_level_xmax <- max(
  c(
    ssa_goal_final_p2025_level_plot$current_p2025_pct,
    ssa_goal_final_p2025_level_labels$label_x
  ),
  na.rm = TRUE
) + 1

ggplot(
  ssa_goal_final_p2025_level_plot,
  aes(x = current_p2025_pct, y = display_label, fill = goal_fill_group)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.74, alpha = 0.96) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 40, color = "#B91C1C", linetype = "longdash", linewidth = 0.75) +
  geom_text(
    data = ssa_goal_final_p2025_level_labels,
    aes(x = label_x, y = display_label, label = label_text),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0,
    size = 3.35,
    fontface = "bold",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ssa_goal_final_focus_group_cols) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0, ssa_goal_final_p2025_level_xmax),
    breaks = pretty,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11.2) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8.9, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10.5, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12.2, face = "bold", color = "black"),
    axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.42),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.36),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 15.3, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11.1, lineheight = 1.03),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 60, 10, 10)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Goals - final:\nestimated mCPR(2025) for weighted SSA, weighted priority geographies, and all SSA countries",
    subtitle = "Bars are ordered as weighted SSA, weighted priority geographies, the seven priority countries, then all remaining SSA countries. Labels are shown for all bars.",
    x = "Estimated mCPR(2025) (%)",
    y = NULL,
    fill = NULL
  )
```

## SSA outliers relative to the weighted regional benchmark

This section asks a simple comparative question: which countries sit above or below the weighted SSA benchmark on two core dimensions:
a) fitted ceiling `K`;
b) current model-implied annual growth at 2026.

The regional benchmark is always the population-weighted SSA benchmark derived from the main country model.

```{r ssa-outlier-stage-setup}
ssa_stage_cols <- c(
  "Stage 1: initial" = "#D55E00",
  "Stage 2: diffusion" = "#0072B2",
  "Stage 3: plateau" = "#009E73"
)

ssa_outlier_k_diff_draws <- sweep(
  ssa_K_draws,
  1,
  ssa_region_K_draws,
  FUN = "-"
)

ssa_outlier_growth_diff_draws <- sweep(
  dpdt_mat[, ssa_country_cols, drop = FALSE],
  1,
  ssa_region_dpdt_2026_draws,
  FUN = "-"
)

ssa_outlier_table <- ssa_goals_country_table %>%
  transmute(
    country,
    region,
    women_15_49,
    women_15_49_millions = women_15_49 / 1e6,
    K_mean,
    model_dpdt_2026_pp_per_year,
    t0_year_mean,
    years_since_t0_2026,
    s_curve_stage_2026
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    k_diff_vs_ssa_pp = 100 * colMeans(ssa_outlier_k_diff_draws),
    growth_diff_vs_ssa_pp_per_year = 100 * colMeans(ssa_outlier_growth_diff_draws),
    prob_k_above_ssa = colMeans(ssa_outlier_k_diff_draws > 0),
    prob_growth_above_ssa = colMeans(ssa_outlier_growth_diff_draws > 0)
  )

ssa_outlier_k_scale <- stats::sd(ssa_outlier_table$k_diff_vs_ssa_pp, na.rm = TRUE)
ssa_outlier_growth_scale <- stats::sd(ssa_outlier_table$growth_diff_vs_ssa_pp_per_year, na.rm = TRUE)
ssa_outlier_k_scale <- ifelse(is.finite(ssa_outlier_k_scale) && ssa_outlier_k_scale > 0, ssa_outlier_k_scale, 1)
ssa_outlier_growth_scale <- ifelse(is.finite(ssa_outlier_growth_scale) && ssa_outlier_growth_scale > 0, ssa_outlier_growth_scale, 1)

ssa_outlier_table <- ssa_outlier_table %>%
  mutate(
    outlier_quadrant = case_when(
      k_diff_vs_ssa_pp >= 0 & growth_diff_vs_ssa_pp_per_year >= 0 ~ "Higher K, higher growth than SSA",
      k_diff_vs_ssa_pp >= 0 & growth_diff_vs_ssa_pp_per_year < 0 ~ "Higher K, lower growth than SSA",
      k_diff_vs_ssa_pp < 0 & growth_diff_vs_ssa_pp_per_year >= 0 ~ "Lower K, higher growth than SSA",
      TRUE ~ "Lower K, lower growth than SSA"
    ),
    outlier_distance = sqrt(
      (k_diff_vs_ssa_pp / ssa_outlier_k_scale)^2 +
        (growth_diff_vs_ssa_pp_per_year / ssa_outlier_growth_scale)^2
    ),
    outlier_label_flag = case_when(
      country %in% c("Nigeria", "Congo Democratic Republic") ~ TRUE,
      outlier_distance >= quantile(outlier_distance, 0.86, na.rm = TRUE) ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    )
  )

ssa_outlier_quadrant_cols <- c(
  "Higher K, higher growth than SSA" = "#1D4ED8",
  "Higher K, lower growth than SSA" = "#D97706",
  "Lower K, higher growth than SSA" = "#059669",
  "Lower K, lower growth than SSA" = "#B91C1C"
)

ssa_region_rel_sat_2026_draws <- pmin(
  pmax(ssa_region_p2026_draws / ssa_region_K_draws, 1e-6),
  1 - 1e-6
)

ssa_region_stage_position_2026_draws <- qlogis(ssa_region_rel_sat_2026_draws)

ssa_region_inflection_year_draws <- apply(
  ssa_region_draws_k_horizon >=
    matrix(
      0.5 * ssa_region_K_draws,
      nrow = nrow(ssa_region_draws_k_horizon),
      ncol = ncol(ssa_region_draws_k_horizon)
    ),
  1,
  function(hit_vec) {
    idx <- which(hit_vec)
    if (length(idx) == 0) NA_real_ else ssa_region_k_horizon_years[min(idx)]
  }
)

ssa_region_stage1_2026 <- ssa_region_stage_position_2026_draws < -1.5
ssa_region_stage3_2026 <- ssa_region_stage_position_2026_draws > 1.5
ssa_region_stage2_2026 <- !(ssa_region_stage1_2026 | ssa_region_stage3_2026)

ssa_region_stage_summary <- tibble(
  geography = "Sub-Saharan Africa (weighted)",
  decision_year = 2026,
  p_2026_mean = mean(ssa_region_p2026_draws),
  K_mean = mean(ssa_region_K_draws),
  rel_sat_2026_mean = mean(ssa_region_rel_sat_2026_draws),
  stage_position_2026_mean = mean(ssa_region_stage_position_2026_draws),
  inflection_year_p50 = if (all(is.na(ssa_region_inflection_year_draws))) NA_real_ else median(ssa_region_inflection_year_draws, na.rm = TRUE),
  inflection_year_p05 = if (all(is.na(ssa_region_inflection_year_draws))) NA_real_ else quantile(ssa_region_inflection_year_draws, ci_lower, na.rm = TRUE),
  inflection_year_p95 = if (all(is.na(ssa_region_inflection_year_draws))) NA_real_ else quantile(ssa_region_inflection_year_draws, ci_upper, na.rm = TRUE),
  prob_stage1_initial_2026 = mean(ssa_region_stage1_2026),
  prob_stage2_diffusion_2026 = mean(ssa_region_stage2_2026),
  prob_stage3_plateau_2026 = mean(ssa_region_stage3_2026)
) %>%
  mutate(
    s_curve_stage_2026 = case_when(
      prob_stage1_initial_2026 >= prob_stage2_diffusion_2026 &
        prob_stage1_initial_2026 >= prob_stage3_plateau_2026 ~ "Stage 1: initial",
      prob_stage3_plateau_2026 >= prob_stage1_initial_2026 &
        prob_stage3_plateau_2026 >= prob_stage2_diffusion_2026 ~ "Stage 3: plateau",
      TRUE ~ "Stage 2: diffusion"
    )
  )

build_weighted_stage_view <- function(
  country_names,
  geography_label,
  weight_mode = c("population", "equal"),
  summary_prefix = "Weighted"
) {
  weight_mode <- match.arg(weight_mode)
  keep_countries <- intersect(country_names, ssa_country_order_vec)
  keep_cols <- match(keep_countries, ssa_country_order_vec)
  keep_weights <- if (weight_mode == "population") {
    ssa_weight_latest$women_15_49[match(keep_countries, ssa_weight_latest$country)]
  } else {
    rep(1, length(keep_countries))
  }
  keep_weights <- keep_weights / sum(keep_weights, na.rm = TRUE)

  keep_K_draws <- ssa_K_draws[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]
  keep_t0_draws <- ssa_t0_draws[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]
  keep_s_draws <- ssa_s_draws[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]

  region_draws_horizon <- sapply(ssa_region_k_horizon_years, function(yy) {
    as.numeric(
      logistic_draws_at_year(keep_K_draws, keep_t0_draws, keep_s_draws, yy) %*%
        keep_weights
    )
  })

  if (is.vector(region_draws_horizon)) {
    region_draws_horizon <- matrix(
      region_draws_horizon,
      nrow = nrow(keep_K_draws),
      ncol = length(ssa_region_k_horizon_years)
    )
  }

  region_K_draws <- as.numeric(keep_K_draws %*% keep_weights)
  region_p2025_draws <- region_draws_horizon[, match(2025, ssa_region_k_horizon_years)]
  region_pgoal_draws <- region_draws_horizon[, match(ssa_goal_final_target_year, ssa_region_k_horizon_years)]
  region_rel_sat_2025_draws <- pmin(
    pmax(region_p2025_draws / region_K_draws, 1e-6),
    1 - 1e-6
  )
  region_stage_position_2025_draws <- qlogis(region_rel_sat_2025_draws)

  region_inflection_year_draws <- apply(
    region_draws_horizon >=
      matrix(
        0.5 * region_K_draws,
        nrow = nrow(region_draws_horizon),
        ncol = ncol(region_draws_horizon)
      ),
    1,
    function(hit_vec) {
      idx <- which(hit_vec)
      if (length(idx) == 0) NA_real_ else ssa_region_k_horizon_years[min(idx)]
    }
  )

  region_crossing_draws <- apply(
    region_draws_horizon >= target_mcpr_40,
    1,
    function(hit_vec) {
      idx <- which(hit_vec)
      if (length(idx) == 0) NA_real_ else ssa_region_k_horizon_years[min(idx)]
    }
  )

  region_stage1_2025 <- region_stage_position_2025_draws < -1.5
  region_stage3_2025 <- region_stage_position_2025_draws > 1.5
  region_stage2_2025 <- !(region_stage1_2025 | region_stage3_2025)

  region_stage_summary <- tibble(
    geography = geography_label,
    p_2025_mean = mean(region_p2025_draws),
    K_mean = mean(region_K_draws),
    rel_sat_2025_mean = mean(region_rel_sat_2025_draws),
    stage_position_2025_mean = mean(region_stage_position_2025_draws),
    inflection_year_p50 = if (all(is.na(region_inflection_year_draws))) NA_real_ else median(region_inflection_year_draws, na.rm = TRUE),
    inflection_year_p05 = if (all(is.na(region_inflection_year_draws))) NA_real_ else quantile(region_inflection_year_draws, ci_lower, na.rm = TRUE),
    inflection_year_p95 = if (all(is.na(region_inflection_year_draws))) NA_real_ else quantile(region_inflection_year_draws, ci_upper, na.rm = TRUE),
    crossing_year_p50 = if (all(is.na(region_crossing_draws))) NA_real_ else median(region_crossing_draws, na.rm = TRUE),
    crossing_year_p05 = if (all(is.na(region_crossing_draws))) NA_real_ else quantile(region_crossing_draws, ci_lower, na.rm = TRUE),
    crossing_year_p95 = if (all(is.na(region_crossing_draws))) NA_real_ else quantile(region_crossing_draws, ci_upper, na.rm = TRUE),
    p_goal_year_mean = mean(region_pgoal_draws),
    p_goal_year_p05 = quantile(region_pgoal_draws, ci_lower, na.rm = TRUE),
    p_goal_year_p95 = quantile(region_pgoal_draws, ci_upper, na.rm = TRUE),
    prob_reach_40_by_goal_year = mean(!is.na(region_crossing_draws) & region_crossing_draws <= ssa_goal_final_target_year),
    prob_stage1_initial_2025 = mean(region_stage1_2025),
    prob_stage2_diffusion_2025 = mean(region_stage2_2025),
    prob_stage3_plateau_2025 = mean(region_stage3_2025)
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      s_curve_stage_2025 = case_when(
        prob_stage1_initial_2025 >= prob_stage2_diffusion_2025 &
          prob_stage1_initial_2025 >= prob_stage3_plateau_2025 ~ "Stage 1: initial",
        prob_stage3_plateau_2025 >= prob_stage1_initial_2025 &
          prob_stage3_plateau_2025 >= prob_stage2_diffusion_2025 ~ "Stage 3: plateau",
        TRUE ~ "Stage 2: diffusion"
      ),
      plot_end_year = 2060
    )

  region_stage_plot <- tibble(
    year = ssa_region_k_horizon_years,
    p_mean = colMeans(region_draws_horizon),
    p_p05 = apply(region_draws_horizon, 2, quantile, ci_lower, na.rm = TRUE),
    p_p95 = apply(region_draws_horizon, 2, quantile, ci_upper, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
    filter(year <= region_stage_summary$plot_end_year[[1]])

  region_stage_note <- paste0(
    "Stage at 2025: ", region_stage_summary$s_curve_stage_2025,
    "\n", summary_prefix, " K: ", round(100 * region_stage_summary$K_mean, 1), "%",
    "\n", summary_prefix, " estimated mCPR(2025): ", round(100 * region_stage_summary$p_2025_mean, 1), "%",
    "\n", summary_prefix, " estimated mCPR(", ssa_goal_final_target_year, "): ", round(100 * region_stage_summary$p_goal_year_mean, 1), "%",
    "\nP(reach 40% by ", ssa_goal_final_target_year, "): ", round(100 * region_stage_summary$prob_reach_40_by_goal_year, 1), "%",
    "\nInflection year: ", round(region_stage_summary$inflection_year_p50, 1),
    " (95% CrI ", round(region_stage_summary$inflection_year_p05, 1),
    "-", round(region_stage_summary$inflection_year_p95, 1), ")"
  )

  list(
    summary = region_stage_summary,
    plot = region_stage_plot,
    note = region_stage_note
  )
}

plot_weighted_ssa_stage_view <- function(
  stage_plot_df,
  stage_summary_df,
  stage_note_text,
  title_text,
  subtitle_text,
  k_label_prefix = "Weighted",
  y_axis_label = "Population-weighted model mCPR (%)"
) {
  stage_summary_plot_df <- if ("p_2025_plot_mean" %in% names(stage_summary_df)) {
    stage_summary_df %>%
      mutate(p_2025_plot_mean = dplyr::coalesce(p_2025_plot_mean, p_2025_mean))
  } else {
    stage_summary_df %>%
      mutate(p_2025_plot_mean = p_2025_mean)
  }
  stage_goal_y <- 40
  stage_k_y <- 100 * stage_summary_df$K_mean
  stage_year_min <- min(stage_plot_df$year, na.rm = TRUE)
  stage_year_mid <- (stage_year_min + 2060) / 2
  stage_label_x <- max(stage_plot_df$year, na.rm = TRUE) - 1.9
  stage_note_x <- min(stage_plot_df$year, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.15
  stage_goal_col <- "#B91C1C"
  stage_k_col <- "#6B4F1D"
  stage_curve_col <- "#15803D"
  stage_inflection_col <- "#1D4ED8"
  stage_goal_year_col <- "#374151"
  stage_current_col <- "#0F172A"
  stage_p2025_display_y <- 100 * stage_summary_df$p_2025_mean
  stage_p2025_plot_y <- 100 * stage_summary_plot_df$p_2025_plot_mean
  stage_p2025_label <- paste0("Estimated mCPR(2025): ", round(stage_p2025_display_y, 1), "%")
  stage_pgoal_y <- 100 * stage_summary_df$p_goal_year_mean
  stage_pgoal_label <- paste0(
    "Estimated mCPR(",
    ssa_goal_final_target_year,
    "): ",
    round(stage_pgoal_y, 1),
    "%"
  )
  stage_y_upper <- min(
    100,
    max(
      56,
      100 * max(stage_plot_df$p_p95, na.rm = TRUE) + 9,
      stage_k_y + 9,
      stage_p2025_plot_y + 8,
      stage_pgoal_y + 9,
      stage_goal_y + 10
    )
  )
  stage_pgoal_label_y <- ifelse(
    stage_pgoal_y <= stage_y_upper - 10,
    stage_pgoal_y + 3.2,
    stage_pgoal_y - 5.0
  )
  stage_pgoal_label_vjust <- ifelse(stage_pgoal_y <= stage_y_upper - 10, 0, 1)
  stage_reference_lines <- tibble::tibble(
    reference_label = c(
      "40% goal",
      "Fitted K",
      "Inflection year",
      paste0("Goal year (", ssa_goal_final_target_year, ")")
    ),
    reference_color = c(
      stage_goal_col,
      stage_k_col,
      stage_inflection_col,
      stage_goal_year_col
    ),
    reference_linetype = c(
      "solid",
      "dotted",
      "dotdash",
      "longdash"
    )
  )
  stage_reference_breaks <- stage_reference_lines$reference_label
  stage_reference_legend <- stage_reference_lines %>%
    mutate(
      x = stage_year_min,
      xend = stage_year_min + 1.5,
      y = -100,
      yend = -100
    )

  ggplot(stage_plot_df, aes(x = year, y = 100 * p_mean)) +
    geom_ribbon(
      aes(ymin = 100 * p_p05, ymax = 100 * p_p95),
      fill = "#CBD5E1",
      alpha = 0.40
    ) +
    geom_line(
      aes(y = 100 * p_p05),
      color = "#64748B",
      linewidth = 0.48,
      alpha = 0.95
    ) +
    geom_line(
      aes(y = 100 * p_p95),
      color = "#64748B",
      linewidth = 0.48,
      alpha = 0.95
    ) +
    geom_line(
      color = stage_curve_col,
      linewidth = 1.45
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = stage_summary_plot_df,
      aes(x = 2025, y = 100 * p_2025_plot_mean),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      shape = 21,
      size = 4.1,
      stroke = 0.7,
      fill = "white",
      color = stage_current_col
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = stage_summary_df,
      aes(x = ssa_goal_final_target_year, xend = ssa_goal_final_target_year, y = 0, yend = 100 * p_goal_year_mean),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      color = stage_goal_year_col,
      linetype = "longdash",
      linewidth = 0.65,
      alpha = 0.95
    ) +
    geom_point(
      data = stage_summary_df,
      aes(x = ssa_goal_final_target_year, y = 100 * p_goal_year_mean),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      shape = 23,
      size = 3.9,
      stroke = 0.45,
      fill = stage_goal_year_col,
      color = "white"
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      data = tibble::tibble(reference_label = "40% goal", yintercept = stage_goal_y),
      aes(yintercept = yintercept, color = reference_label, linetype = reference_label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linewidth = 0.95,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_hline(
      data = tibble::tibble(reference_label = "Fitted K", yintercept = stage_k_y),
      aes(yintercept = yintercept, color = reference_label, linetype = reference_label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linewidth = 1.0,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      data = tibble::tibble(reference_label = "Inflection year", xintercept = stage_summary_df$inflection_year_p50),
      aes(xintercept = xintercept, color = reference_label, linetype = reference_label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linewidth = 0.9,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      data = tibble::tibble(reference_label = paste0("Goal year (", ssa_goal_final_target_year, ")"), xintercept = ssa_goal_final_target_year),
      aes(xintercept = xintercept, color = reference_label, linetype = reference_label),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linewidth = 0.85,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    geom_segment(
      data = stage_reference_legend,
      aes(
        x = x,
        xend = xend,
        y = y,
        yend = yend,
        color = reference_label,
        linetype = reference_label
      ),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      linewidth = 1.05,
      key_glyph = ggplot2::draw_key_path
    ) +
    annotate(
      "label",
      x = 2026.4,
      y = pmax(6.8, stage_p2025_plot_y - 6.3),
      label = stage_p2025_label,
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 0,
      size = 3.8,
      fontface = "bold",
      label.size = 0.2,
      label.padding = unit(0.2, "lines"),
      fill = "#F8FAFC",
      color = stage_current_col
    ) +
    annotate(
      "label",
      x = ssa_goal_final_target_year + 1.15,
      y = stage_pgoal_label_y,
      label = stage_pgoal_label,
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = stage_pgoal_label_vjust,
      size = 3.8,
      fontface = "bold",
      label.size = 0.2,
      label.padding = unit(0.2, "lines"),
      fill = "#F8FAFC",
      color = stage_goal_year_col
    ) +
    annotate(
      "label",
      x = stage_year_mid,
      y = stage_goal_y + 1.8,
      label = "40% goal",
      hjust = 0.5,
      vjust = 0,
      size = 4.75,
      fontface = "bold",
      label.size = 0.25,
      fill = "#FEF2F2",
      color = stage_goal_col
    ) +
    annotate(
      "label",
      x = stage_label_x,
      y = pmin(stage_y_upper - 6.0, stage_k_y + 2.8),
      label = paste0(k_label_prefix, " K: ", round(stage_k_y, 1), "%"),
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 0,
      size = 4.85,
      fontface = "bold",
      label.size = 0.25,
      fill = "#FFFBEB",
      color = stage_k_col
    ) +
    annotate(
      "label",
      x = stage_note_x,
      y = stage_y_upper - 1.1,
      label = stage_note_text,
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 4.15,
      lineheight = 1.03,
      fontface = "bold",
      label.size = 0.18,
      label.padding = unit(0.24, "lines"),
      fill = "white",
      color = "grey15"
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = sort(unique(c(
        seq(
          floor(min(stage_plot_df$year, na.rm = TRUE) / 5) * 5,
          2060,
          by = 5
        ),
        ssa_goal_final_target_year
      )))
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, stage_y_upper),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(
      xlim = c(min(stage_plot_df$year, na.rm = TRUE) - 0.8, 2062),
      ylim = c(0, stage_y_upper),
      clip = "off"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13.4) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      axis.line.x = element_line(color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.65),
      axis.line.y = element_line(color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.65),
      axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.55),
      axis.ticks.y = element_line(color = "grey20", linewidth = 0.55),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 15.2, face = "bold", color = "black"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 13.8, color = "black"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16.8, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, color = "black"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12.9, lineheight = 1.08, hjust = 0.5, color = "black"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 13.1, color = "black"),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 34, 10, 8)
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = stats::setNames(stage_reference_lines$reference_color, stage_reference_lines$reference_label),
      breaks = stage_reference_breaks,
      guide = guide_legend(
        order = 1,
        override.aes = list(
          linewidth = 1.05,
          linetype = unname(stage_reference_lines$reference_linetype[match(stage_reference_breaks, stage_reference_lines$reference_label)])
        )
      )
    ) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = stats::setNames(stage_reference_lines$reference_linetype, stage_reference_lines$reference_label),
      breaks = stage_reference_breaks,
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title_text,
      subtitle = subtitle_text,
      x = "Year",
      y = y_axis_label
    )
}
```

### Outlier map: K and growth relative to weighted SSA

This map is the quickest visual way to see over- and underperformance relative to the weighted SSA benchmark.

Interpretation:
a) points to the right have a higher fitted `K` than the weighted SSA region;
b) points above zero have faster current model-implied growth than the weighted SSA region;
c) point size shows women age 15-49 population;
d) countries far from the origin are the clearest outliers relative to the weighted SSA benchmark.

```{r ssa-outlier-map}
ggplot(
  ssa_outlier_table,
  aes(
    x = k_diff_vs_ssa_pp,
    y = growth_diff_vs_ssa_pp_per_year,
    size = women_15_49_millions,
    fill = outlier_quadrant
  )
) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey45", linewidth = 0.45) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted", color = "grey45", linewidth = 0.45) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, color = "grey15", alpha = 0.9, stroke = 0.35) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    data = ssa_outlier_table %>% filter(outlier_label_flag),
    aes(label = country),
    size = 3,
    color = "grey15",
    segment.alpha = 0.35,
    min.segment.length = 0
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ssa_outlier_quadrant_cols) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 16, name = "Women 15-49\n(millions)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10.5) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "SSA outlier map: fitted K and current growth relative to the weighted regional benchmark",
    subtitle = "Right of zero means a country's fitted ceiling is above weighted SSA K; above zero means current model-implied growth at 2026 is above weighted SSA growth",
    x = "Country K minus weighted SSA K (percentage points)",
    y = "Country growth minus weighted SSA growth at 2026 (pp/year)"
  )
```

## S-curve stage positioning for the weighted SSA region and all SSA countries

This section keeps the same logistic stage logic as the country stage classification above. For the weighted regional views, we classify the weighted curve at `2025`, so the marked current position and the reported stage are aligned. For the country panels below, the existing `2026` stage rule is unchanged.

### Weighted SSA region on the S curve

The colored SSA curve below is the **population-weighted regional `p(year)` implied by the fitted country Bayesian model**. The horizontal lines mark the **40% goal** and the **weighted fitted `K`**; the vertical guides mark the inflection year and the goal-year projection; the dark current marker highlights the **estimated mCPR(2025)**; and the top-left box summarizes the **estimated mCPR(2045)** and the model-implied probability of being at or above 40% by then. The projection line continues through `2060`.

### Every SSA country on the S curve

Each panel uses the 2026 S-curve stage classification and shows the country trajectory, fitted `K`, and inflection year directly.

How the 3-stage classification is calculated here:
a) we ask where each country sits on its fitted S curve in `2026`, relative to its own fitted ceiling `K` and inflection year;
b) `Stage 1: initial` means the country is still in the early part of the transition, well before the steep takeoff phase, and still far below its fitted ceiling;
c) `Stage 2: diffusion` means the country is in the middle of the transition, where growth is most active and the curve is moving through its steepest part;
d) `Stage 3: plateau` means the country is in the late part of the transition, after the steep growth phase, and is flattening toward its fitted ceiling;
e) operationally, we classify countries by how far along the fitted curve they are in `2026`: below about `18%` of fitted `K` is `Stage 1`, roughly `18%` to `82%` of fitted `K` is `Stage 2`, and above about `82%` of fitted `K` is `Stage 3`;
f) because this is Bayesian, the model does this across posterior draws, and the stage shown in the figure is the one with the highest posterior probability.

For the weighted SSA region, we use the same logic after first aggregating the country trajectories into a single population-weighted SSA curve and comparing the weighted `p(2026)` to the weighted fitted `K`.

Line guide for the figure:
a) the colored line and ribbon show the posterior mean trajectory and 95% credible interval;
b) the ochre dotted horizontal line marks fitted `K`;
c) the blue dotted vertical line marks the inflection year `t0`;
d) the dark dashed vertical line marks the goal year `2045`.

```{r ssa-stage-country-trajectories, fig.height=24}
ggplot(ssa_stage_country_plot, aes(x = year, y = 100 * p_mean)) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(
      ymin = 100 * p_p05,
      ymax = 100 * p_p95
    ),
    fill = "#CBD5E1",
    alpha = 0.30
  ) +
  geom_line(
    aes(
      y = 100 * p_p05,
      group = stage_panel_label
    ),
    color = "#94A3B8",
    linewidth = 0.28,
    alpha = 0.95
  ) +
  geom_line(
    aes(
      y = 100 * p_p95,
      group = stage_panel_label
    ),
    color = "#94A3B8",
    linewidth = 0.28,
    alpha = 0.95
  ) +
  geom_line(
    aes(color = s_curve_stage_2026),
    linewidth = 0.94
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = ssa_stage_country_obs,
    aes(x = year, y = mcp_pct),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    color = "black",
    size = 1.3,
    alpha = 0.68
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = ssa_stage_country_meta,
    aes(x = 2026, y = 100 * p2026_mean, fill = s_curve_stage_2026),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    shape = 21,
    size = 1.9,
    stroke = 0.25,
    color = "white"
  ) +
  geom_hline(
    data = ssa_stage_country_meta,
    aes(yintercept = 100 * K_mean, linetype = "Fitted K"),
    color = "#8A5A00",
    linewidth = 0.72,
    alpha = 0.95
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    data = ssa_stage_country_meta,
    aes(xintercept = t0_year_mean, linetype = "Inflection year"),
    color = "#1D4ED8",
    linewidth = 0.74,
    alpha = 0.98
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    data = tibble(goal_year = ssa_goal_final_target_year, line_key = paste0("Goal year (", ssa_goal_final_target_year, ")")),
    aes(xintercept = goal_year, linetype = line_key),
    color = "grey15",
    linewidth = 0.8,
    alpha = 0.98
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ stage_panel_label, ncol = 4, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_color_manual(values = ssa_stage_cols, name = "Stage at 2026") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = ssa_stage_cols, name = "Stage at 2026") +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    name = "Reference lines",
    values = setNames(
      c("dotted", "dotted", "longdash"),
      c(
        "Fitted K",
        "Inflection year",
        paste0("Goal year (", ssa_goal_final_target_year, ")")
      )
    ),
    breaks = c("Fitted K", "Inflection year", paste0("Goal year (", ssa_goal_final_target_year, ")"))
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = function(x) {
      brks <- pretty(x, n = 4)
      brks[brks != ssa_goal_final_target_year]
    },
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 100), clip = "off") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 9.4) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey88", linewidth = 0.3),
    axis.line.x = element_line(color = "grey25", linewidth = 0.45),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "grey25", linewidth = 0.4),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 7.5, lineheight = 0.95),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8.4, color = "grey15"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "grey15"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10.8, margin = margin(t = 7)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9.4),
    plot.margin = margin(6, 8, 14, 8)
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      order = 1,
      override.aes = list(linewidth = 1.05, alpha = 1)
    ),
    linetype = guide_legend(
      order = 2,
      override.aes = list(
        color = c("#8A5A00", "#1D4ED8", "grey15"),
        linewidth = c(0.72, 0.74, 0.8)
      )
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "SSA country S-curve stages at 2026",
    subtitle = paste0("Panels are ordered by stage. The grey ribbon and thin boundary lines show the 95% credible interval around the fitted trajectory, stage colors reflect the modal posterior stage at 2026, and the reference-line legend distinguishes fitted K, the inflection year, and the ", ssa_goal_final_target_year, " goal year."),
    x = "Year",
    y = "mCPR (%)"
  )
```

### Focused S-curve subset: SSA weighted, priority weighted, and the 7 priority countries

This companion view keeps the most decision-relevant subset together in one place:
a) the weighted SSA regional curve;
b) the weighted priority-geographies curve;

The dark point now consistently marks the **estimated mCPR(2025)** in every panel. The two weighted panels keep their weighted stage summaries at `2025`; the country panels keep the same country-level stage classification used above.

## Global posterior predicted trajectory

Technical note:
a) A recurring failure mode in this project was `predictor_fe(...)` in global prediction when region-level `newdata` was built from external templates that did not perfectly align with the fitted factor structure.
b) This chunk builds region rows from the fitted DHS data itself and checks `region_prior`, `s_region_fixed`, and region weights before prediction.

```{r global-posterior-predicted}
# Compute and plot global posterior trajectory with 95% credible interval.
year_grid_global <- seq(min(mcpr_logistic_data$year, na.rm = TRUE), 2036, by = 1)

# Build a population-level grid by region and year, then aggregate with region weights.
# IMPORTANT:
# For nonlinear brms prediction, `newdata` must carry predictor columns with the same
# classes/levels as the fitted model design matrix. We build from mcpr_logistic_data
# directly to avoid `predictor_fe` errors from mismatched factor levels or missing joins.
region_profile <- mcpr_logistic_data %>%
  distinct(region_prior, s_region_fixed) %>%
  filter(!is.na(region_prior), !is.na(s_region_fixed)) %>%
  mutate(region_prior = as.character(region_prior)) %>%
  arrange(region_prior)

region_weights <- mcpr_logistic_data %>%
  distinct(country, region_prior) %>%
  mutate(region_prior = as.character(region_prior)) %>%
  count(region_prior, name = "n_country") %>%
  inner_join(region_profile %>% select(region_prior), by = "region_prior") %>%
  mutate(weight = n_country / sum(n_country))

nd_global <- tidyr::crossing(
  region_profile,
  year = year_grid_global
) %>%
  mutate(
    region_prior = as.character(region_prior),
    country = as.character(mcpr_logistic_data$country[1]),
    year_center = year - 2000,
    n = 1L,
    y = 0L
  ) %>%
  left_join(region_weights %>% select(region_prior, weight), by = "region_prior")

if (any(is.na(nd_global$region_prior))) {
  stop("nd_global contains NA region_prior; cannot run posterior prediction.")
}
if (any(is.na(nd_global$s_region_fixed))) {
  stop("nd_global contains NA s_region_fixed; cannot run posterior prediction.")
}
if (any(is.na(nd_global$weight))) {
  stop("nd_global contains NA region weights; cannot run global aggregation.")
}

ep_global_region <- posterior_epred(fit_logistic, newdata = nd_global, re_formula = NA)

# Weighted average over region-specific fitted curves for each posterior draw and year.
ep_global <- sapply(year_grid_global, function(yy) {
  idx <- which(nd_global$year == yy)
  ep_global_region[, idx, drop = FALSE] %*% nd_global$weight[idx]
})

global_curve <- tibble(
  year = year_grid_global,
  p_mean = colMeans(ep_global),
  p_lo = apply(ep_global, 2, quantile, ci_lower),
  p_hi = apply(ep_global, 2, quantile, ci_upper)
)

obs_all <- mcpr_logistic_data %>% select(year, mCPR)

ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = obs_all, aes(x = year, y = mCPR), alpha = 0.20, size = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(data = global_curve, aes(x = year, ymin = p_lo, ymax = p_hi), alpha = 0.20) +
  geom_line(data = global_curve, aes(x = year, y = p_mean), linewidth = 1) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = "Global posterior predicted mCPR trajectory",
    subtitle = "Region-weighted population-level fit (excluding country random effects), with 95% credible interval",
    x = "Year",
    y = "mCPR"
  )
```

## Implied growth and acceleration (global posterior)

This section reports derivatives of the posterior mean global trajectory:

a) First derivative \(dp/dt\): implied growth rate.
b) Second derivative \(d^2p/dt^2\): implied acceleration or deceleration.

```{r global-posterior-derivatives}
# Derive and plot first/second derivatives with posterior uncertainty bands.
global_curve_deriv <- global_curve %>%
  arrange(year) %>%
  mutate(
    dp_dt = (lead(p_mean) - lag(p_mean)) / (lead(year) - lag(year)),
    d2p_dt2 = (lead(p_mean) - 2 * p_mean + lag(p_mean)) / (((lead(year) - lag(year)) / 2)^2)
  )

# ep_global has dimensions: draws x years (created in global-posterior-predicted chunk).
n_year <- ncol(ep_global)
if (n_year >= 3) {
  # Central-difference derivatives by posterior draw.
  dp_draws <- sapply(2:(n_year - 1), function(j) {
    (ep_global[, j + 1] - ep_global[, j - 1]) / (year_grid_global[j + 1] - year_grid_global[j - 1])
  })

  d2p_draws <- sapply(2:(n_year - 1), function(j) {
    (ep_global[, j + 1] - 2 * ep_global[, j] + ep_global[, j - 1]) /
      (((year_grid_global[j + 1] - year_grid_global[j - 1]) / 2)^2)
  })

  deriv_ci <- tibble(
    year = year_grid_global[2:(n_year - 1)],
    dp_p05 = apply(dp_draws, 2, quantile, probs = ci_lower, na.rm = TRUE),
    dp_p50 = apply(dp_draws, 2, quantile, probs = 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
    dp_p95 = apply(dp_draws, 2, quantile, probs = ci_upper, na.rm = TRUE),
    d2p_p05 = apply(d2p_draws, 2, quantile, probs = ci_lower, na.rm = TRUE),
    d2p_p50 = apply(d2p_draws, 2, quantile, probs = 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
    d2p_p95 = apply(d2p_draws, 2, quantile, probs = ci_upper, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

  ggplot(deriv_ci, aes(x = year, y = dp_p50)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = dp_p05, ymax = dp_p95), alpha = 0.20, fill = "#6BAED6") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1, color = "#2171B5") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    labs(
      title = "Global implied growth rate (first derivative)",
      subtitle = "Median with 95% credible interval",
      x = "Year",
      y = "dp/dt"
    )

  ggplot(deriv_ci, aes(x = year, y = d2p_p50)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = d2p_p05, ymax = d2p_p95), alpha = 0.20, fill = "#F4A582") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1, color = "#CA0020") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    labs(
      title = "Global implied acceleration (second derivative)",
      subtitle = "Median with 95% credible interval",
      x = "Year",
      y = "d2p/dt2"
    )
}
```

# Exploratory regional check: latest observed mCPR by region

This exploratory section aggregates each country's most recent observed mCPR and compares the distribution across the eight analytic regions.

```{r exploratory-latest-mcpr-region}
# Keep one row per country: the latest non-missing observed survey value.
latest_country_obs <- mcpr_logistic_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(mCPR), !is.na(year)) %>%
  group_by(country, region) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = year, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(country, region, last_year = year, last_mcpr = mCPR)

# Summarize latest country values within each region.
latest_region_summary <- latest_country_obs %>%
  group_by(region) %>%
  summarise(
    n_countries = n(),
    mean_last_mcpr = mean(last_mcpr, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_last_mcpr = median(last_mcpr, na.rm = TRUE),
    p25_last_mcpr = quantile(last_mcpr, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    p75_last_mcpr = quantile(last_mcpr, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_last_mcpr = min(last_mcpr, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_last_mcpr = max(last_mcpr, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(region)

knitr::kable(
  latest_region_summary %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 4))),
  caption = "Latest observed country mCPR by region (country-last observation summary)"
)
```
